result.description: Compact field recorder built for spoken-word capture, ambient sampling, and archival note-taking. Features dual XLR/line inputs, onboard stereo microphones, USB-C file transfer, hardware gain knobs, and a rechargeable battery for mobile sessions. The internal flash storage is optimized for long-form audio logging and quick export to editing software.
